name: snipara-context
description: Context optimization and semantic search for OpenClaw via Snipara
author: Snipara

tools.name: context_query
tools.description: Query documentation for relevant context with semantic search and token budgeting. Returns only the most relevant sections within your token limit.

query.description: Question or topic to search for

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to return (budget your context window)

searchMode.description: Search mode: keyword (exact match), semantic (meaning), or hybrid (both)

includeMetadata.description: Include file paths and relevance scores

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a document for indexing. Snipara will chunk and embed it for semantic search.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search documentation for a regex pattern. Good for finding exact matches.

tools.name: decompose
tools.description: Break a complex query into sub-queries with execution order. Use for multi-part questions.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Generate an execution plan for a complex question. Returns ordered steps with dependencies.

maxTokens.description: Total token budget for the plan

tools.name: multi_query
tools.description: Execute multiple queries in one call. More efficient than individual calls.

totalMaxTokens.description: Total token budget across all queries

tools.name: sections
tools.description: List all indexed documentation sections. Use to explore available content.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Get documentation statistics for the project.
